semiconductor_relevance: High — Hamai.Co., Ltd. specializes in precision machine tools for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in lapping and polishing processes.
summary: Hamai.Co., Ltd. has been a key player in the manufacturing of precision machine tools since 1921, focusing on lapping and polishing equipment for various applications including silicon wafers. Their double side lapping and polishing machines are among the largest in the world, catering to the semiconductor industry and other high-precision fields.
capabilities: Double side lapping and polishing machines
Lapping and polishing equipment for silicon wafers
Polishing machines for hard disk substrates
